contexts.text: Pharaoh's cup was in my hand () = the influx of the interior Natural into what is exterior, and the beginning of reception... Cup = that which contains, and at the same time that which is contained.
To press out into Pharaoh's cup = reciprocal influx. Explained.
I gave the cup upon Pharaoh's palm = appropriation by the interior Natural.

A cup, cup, or cup = spiritual truth, that is, the truth of faith which is from the good of charity, the same as wine; and in the opposite, the falsity through which is evil, and also falsity from evil. The reason a cup has a similar signification to wine, is that a cup is the containant, and wine is what is contained; thus they constitute one thing, and therefore the one is meant by the other. Illustrated. AC 5144. AE 960:2.
Under Cup, see these references. AC 9996:2.
Cup = insanity from falsities and consequent evils. Illustrated.
Thou shalt give Pharaoh's cup into his hand () = that they shall serve the interior Natural. To give a cup to drink = to appropriate; and also to serve.

My cup, the silver cup, thou shalt put into the sack's mouth of the youngest () = interior truth given to the medium. A silver cup = the truth of faith from the good of charity; and as it was Joseph's cup, it = interior truth. AC 5747.
The bowls, etc (of the candlestick, ) = spiritual things in what is natural... because they were productions from the candlestick, as the palms are from the body.
Three bowls made like almonds () = what is full as to scientifics from good... Bowls = the scientific truths which are from the good of charity.
Four bowls made like almonds () = the scientifics of truth from good. Bowls made like almonds = scientifics from good.
Under Cup, see these references. AE 960:2.
He said, I will drink out of an invisible cup.
As clear as water in a crystal cup.
I saw glass cups full of wine and sugar.
Bowls of wine from which they drink () = the external truths from which is worship. ( = to adduce many things from the Word, so that they may appear. AE 448:12.)
